title: Advance Disabled Once Delivered
description: A shipment that's already arrived has nowhere further to go — clicking "Advance" on a delivered shipment shouldn't do anything, and the button should say so by disabling itself the moment delivery happens.
successCondition: As a dispatcher or admin, repeatedly clicking a shipment's "Advance" button (through booked -> in_transit -> ... -> delivered) leaves the button enabled at every intermediate status, and the moment the shipment's Badge reads "delivered", that same row's "Advance" button becomes disabled — verified by attempting one more click after delivery and confirming the status and position stay unchanged.
hints: The number of clicks needed to reach "delivered" depends on the shipment's distance — a short domestic route reaches it in fewer ticks than a long international one.
disabled={s.status === "delivered"} is the exact condition — a stale prop or missed re-render could leave the button clickable one tick too long.
